shared_elements: human figure in profile, low relief
long garment with patterned or pleated fabric
raised/extended arm and hands rendered in profile
procession or striding orientation to one side
relief carved on architectural stone block surface
justification: Both show bearded male figures in strict profile low relief wearing long patterned robes, with hands and arms rendered in profile and a striding/processional orientation, and both are carved on jointed stone wall blocks. However, A is a multi-figure procession including a large camel led by tribute-bearers beneath a rosette border, while B is a single monumental winged figure with raised hand and no animals, border or attendants, so the scene content and composition differ substantially.
